blocks.zh: 9.0 Master Planning for Cleaning Validation | 清潔驗證總體規劃
blocks.en: 9.0 Master Planning for Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: Defining the overarching strategy, rationale, and documentation framework | 定義總體策略、原理依據與文件架構
blocks.en: Defining the overarching strategy, rationale, and documentation framework

blocks.zh: 中文解說與重點補充
blocks.en: Commentary and Additional Key Points

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證總體計畫（CVMP）是什麼？
blocks.en: What Is a Cleaning Validation Master Plan (CVMP)?

blocks.zh: Cleaning Validation Master Plan（CVMP） 是整個清潔驗證計畫的「憲法文件」，定義範圍、策略、責任分工與執行方法。它不是一份靜態文件，而是活的文件（living document），需定期審查更新。
blocks.en: The Cleaning Validation Master Plan (CVMP) is the "constitutional document" of the whole cleaning validation program, defining the scope, strategy, division of responsibilities, and execution methods. It is not a static document but a living document that must be reviewed and updated periodically.

blocks.zh: CVMP 的層次架構：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of the CVMP:

blocks.zh: 廠址驗證總體計畫（Site VMP） — 最高層，涵蓋所有驗證活動
blocks.en: Site Validation Master Plan (Site VMP) - the top level, covering all validation activities

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證總體計畫（CVMP） — 專屬清潔驗證的策略文件
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation Master Plan (CVMP) - the strategy document dedicated to cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 執行/專案計畫 — 詳細技術要求與流程
blocks.en: Execution/project plans - detailed technical requirements and processes

blocks.zh: 個別方案（Protocols） — 具體設備或製程的驗證程序
blocks.en: Individual protocols - validation procedures for specific equipment or processes

blocks.zh: 法規稽查重點提示
blocks.en: Reminder on Regulatory Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 法規稽查員（FDA、EMA 等）通常會要求查閱 CVMP，再深入查看個別驗證方案與最終報告，以確認：
blocks.en: Regulatory inspectors (FDA, EMA, etc.) will usually ask to see the CVMP, then look more deeply at individual validation protocols and final reports to confirm:

blocks.zh: 計畫內容是否合理且符合科學依據
blocks.en: Whether the content of the plan is reasonable and scientifically justified

blocks.zh: 實際執行是否確實遵循計畫
blocks.en: Whether actual execution follows the plan

blocks.zh: 計畫的架構是否完整且可追溯
blocks.en: Whether the structure of the plan is complete and traceable

blocks.zh: 因此，CVMP 的品質直接影響稽查結果。
blocks.en: The quality of the CVMP therefore directly affects the inspection outcome.

blocks.zh: 比喻：工程藍圖
blocks.en: Analogy: Construction Blueprints

blocks.zh: CVMP 就像蓋大樓的「工程藍圖」：藍圖說明整體設計概念和原則，而各樓層的施工圖（個別方案）則包含具體尺寸和細節。稽查員先看藍圖，再抽查施工圖，確認兩者一致。
blocks.en: The CVMP is like the "blueprint" for constructing a building: the blueprint describes the overall design concept and principles, while the construction drawings for each floor (individual protocols) contain the specific dimensions and details. The inspector looks at the blueprint first, then spot-checks the construction drawings to confirm that the two are consistent.

blocks.zh: 9.1 Elements of a Comprehensive Plan | 總體計畫的核心要素
blocks.en: 9.1 Elements of a Comprehensive Plan

blocks.zh: The full list of topics a robust CVMP should address | 完整 CVMP 應涵蓋的所有主題
blocks.en: The full list of topics a robust CVMP should address

blocks.zh: 生物製品 CVMP 的獨特要素
blocks.en: Distinctive Elements of a CVMP for Biological Products

blocks.zh: 相較於小分子藥品，生物製品的 CVMP 必須特別涵蓋：
blocks.en: Compared with small-molecule drugs, a CVMP for biological products must specifically cover:

blocks.zh: 生物製品的預清潔與滅活 — 確保蛋白質、核酸等生物物質在清洗前已適當處理
blocks.en: Pre-cleaning and inactivation of biological products - ensure that proteins, nucleic acids, and other biological materials are properly treated before cleaning

blocks.zh: 色譜與超濾系統 — 這些複雜的下游純化設備有獨特的清洗挑戰
blocks.en: Chromatography and ultrafiltration systems - these complex downstream purification units pose unique cleaning challenges

blocks.zh: 上游 vs. 下游設備 — 兩者的污染性質和清洗方法差異顯著
blocks.en: Upstream vs. downstream equipment - the nature of contamination and the cleaning methods differ significantly between the two

blocks.zh: 凍乾機等非產品接觸表面 — 需有明確的策略文件
blocks.en: Non-product-contact surfaces such as freeze dryers - a clear strategy must be documented

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語速查
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Key Terms

blocks.zh: CIP（Clean-in-Place） — 就地清洗，設備不拆卸，透過固定管線循環清洗液
blocks.en: CIP (Clean-in-Place) - cleaning without disassembling the equipment, circulating cleaning solution through fixed piping

blocks.zh: COP（Clean-out-of-Place） — 離線清洗，設備拆卸後送至清洗站清洗
blocks.en: COP (Clean-out-of-Place) - off-line cleaning, in which equipment is disassembled and sent to a wash station for cleaning

blocks.zh: Worst-case Product（最差情況產品） — 最難清除的產品，作為代表性驗證對象
blocks.en: Worst-case Product - the product that is hardest to remove, used as the representative subject of validation

blocks.zh: Family Approach（分組策略） — 將具有相似特性的產品/設備歸組，以最差情況代表整組驗證
blocks.en: Family Approach - grouping products/equipment with similar characteristics so that the worst case represents the whole group in validation

blocks.zh: Design Space（設計空間） — 已建立的清洗參數範圍，在此範圍內操作可確保清潔效果
blocks.en: Design Space - the established range of cleaning parameters within which operation ensures cleaning effectiveness

blocks.zh: Dirty/Clean Hold Time（持有時間） — 清洗前/後設備可存放的最長時間
blocks.en: Dirty/Clean Hold Time - the maximum time equipment may be stored before/after cleaning

blocks.zh: 練習思考 1
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 1

blocks.zh: 情境：你的生物製品工廠正在起草第一份 CVMP。主管問你：「我們只要把每個驗證方案的範圍列表放進去就夠了嗎？」
blocks.en: Scenario: Your biologics plant is drafting its first CVMP. Your manager asks: "Is it enough to simply include a list of the scope of each validation protocol?"

blocks.zh: 問題：根據 TR49 Section 9.1，這樣做有哪些不足？CVMP 還需要哪些額外內容？
blocks.en: Question: According to TR49 Section 9.1, what is inadequate about this approach? What additional content does a CVMP need?

blocks.zh: 參考答案方向：僅列設備清單遠遠不夠。CVMP 至少還需涵蓋：清洗哲學與策略、責任分工、最差條件的定義邏輯、分析方法選擇依據、限度計算原理、變更控制流程，以及生物製品特有的考量（如生物製品滅活、色譜系統）。
blocks.en: Suggested answer direction: A list of equipment alone is far from enough. A CVMP should also cover at least: the cleaning philosophy and strategy, division of responsibilities, the logic for defining worst-case conditions, the rationale for selecting analytical methods, the principles of limit calculation, the change control process, and considerations specific to biological products (such as inactivation of biological products and chromatography systems).

blocks.zh: CVMP 要素分類概覽
blocks.en: Overview of CVMP Element Categories

blocks.zh: TR49 列舉的要素可歸納為六大類別：
blocks.en: The elements listed in TR49 can be grouped into six categories:

blocks.zh: 9.2 Harmonization of Site Cleaning Programs | 廠址清潔程序的協調統一
blocks.en: 9.2 Harmonization of Site Cleaning Programs

blocks.zh: Aligning cleaning validation across multiple manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers | 多廠址及委託製造商之間清潔驗證的協調對齊
blocks.en: Aligning cleaning validation across multiple manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers

blocks.zh: 委託製造商（CMO/CDMO）的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Contract Manufacturers (CMO/CDMO)

blocks.zh: 當產品交由 CMO/CDMO 生產時，清潔驗證的協調更加複雜：
blocks.en: When a product is manufactured by a CMO/CDMO, coordinating cleaning validation becomes more complex:

blocks.zh: CMO 有義務遵循自己的 CVMP，不能完全照搬原廠做法
blocks.en: The CMO is obliged to follow its own CVMP and cannot simply copy the originator's practices

blocks.zh: CMO 的清洗技術和程序可以不同，但驗證結果必須合規
blocks.en: The CMO's cleaning technology and procedures may differ, but the validation results must be compliant

blocks.zh: 任何關鍵差異必須在簽署品質協議（Quality Agreement）前事先明確討論並書面記錄
blocks.en: Any critical differences must be discussed explicitly and documented in writing before the Quality Agreement is signed

blocks.zh: 原廠應對 CMO 的清潔驗證程序進行審查，確保符合雙方的法規期望
blocks.en: The originator should review the CMO's cleaning validation procedures to ensure they meet the regulatory expectations of both parties

blocks.zh: 比喻：連鎖餐廳的標準化
blocks.en: Analogy: Standardization in a Restaurant Chain

blocks.zh: 多廠址協調就像連鎖餐廳的品質管理：各分店的廚房設備、規模可能不同，但使用同樣的食材規格和品質檢驗標準。每家分店有自己的作業程序，但最終都要達到相同的食品安全要求。委外廠商（代工廚房）則須先簽協議，確認能達到相同的品質標準。
blocks.en: Multi-site harmonization is like quality management in a restaurant chain: the kitchen equipment and scale at each branch may differ, but they use the same ingredient specifications and quality inspection standards. Each branch has its own operating procedures, but all must ultimately meet the same food safety requirements. A contract kitchen (outsourced manufacturer) must first sign an agreement confirming that it can meet the same quality standards.

blocks.zh: 多廠址協調統一的三個層次
blocks.en: Three Levels of Multi-Site Harmonization

blocks.zh: TR49 的 Harmonization 原則可分為三個層次：
blocks.en: The Harmonization principles of TR49 can be divided into three levels:

blocks.zh: 9.3 Cleaning Validation Activities as a Function of Clinical Stage | 清潔驗證活動與臨床階段的關係
blocks.en: 9.3 Cleaning Validation Activities as a Function of Clinical Stage

blocks.zh: Scaling validation rigor to match the stage of product development | 依據產品開發階段調整驗證嚴格程度
blocks.en: Scaling validation rigor to match the stage of product development

blocks.zh: Verification vs. Validation — 關鍵區別
blocks.en: Verification vs. Validation: Key Differences

blocks.zh: 清潔確認（Cleaning Verification）：對每批次清洗後進行測試，確認該次清洗結果符合標準。屬於逐批控制。
blocks.en: Cleaning Verification: testing after each batch's cleaning to confirm that the result of that cleaning meets the standard. This is batch-by-batch control.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）：透過一系列有代表性的測試（通常 3 次），建立清洗程序在規定條件下「始終」能達到潔淨標準的科學證明。屬於程序控制。
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation: through a series of representative tests (usually three runs), establishing scientific evidence that the cleaning procedure will "consistently" achieve the cleanliness standard under the specified conditions. This is procedure control.

blocks.zh: 簡言之：Verification 是「每次證明」，Validation 是「一次性建立持久性信心」。
blocks.en: In short: verification is "proof every time," while validation is "establishing lasting confidence once."

blocks.zh: 比喻：新員工 vs. 資深員工
blocks.en: Analogy: New Employee vs. Experienced Employee

blocks.zh: 臨床階段就像新員工試用期：試用期間每天打卡考核（確認），轉正後建立信任機制（驗證），之後定期考核維持（監控）。商業生產就是「正式員工」，必須有完整的驗證文件，不能只靠每批確認。
blocks.en: Clinical stages are like a new employee's probation period: during probation, performance is checked every day (verification); after confirmation, a trust mechanism is established (validation), and periodic assessments follow to maintain it (monitoring). Commercial production is the "permanent employee" and must have complete validation documentation; it cannot rely on batch-by-batch verification alone.

blocks.zh: 10.0 Risk Assessment and Management | 風險評估與管理
blocks.en: 10.0 Risk Assessment and Management

blocks.zh: Applying Quality Risk Management (QRM) principles throughout the cleaning validation life cycle | 將品質風險管理原則應用於清潔驗證生命週期全程
blocks.en: Applying Quality Risk Management (QRM) principles throughout the cleaning validation life cycle

blocks.zh: 10.1 Introduction | 簡介 (PDA TR49, pp. 48–49)
blocks.en: 10.1 Introduction (PDA TR49, pp. 48–49)

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 品質風險管理（QRM）
blocks.en: Commentary: Quality Risk Management (QRM)

blocks.zh: QRM 與 ICH Q9 的連結
blocks.en: The Link Between QRM and ICH Q9

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 品質風險管理 是 QRM 在製藥產業的核心法規框架。TR49 Section 10 與 ICH Q9 高度一致，其基本原則是：
blocks.en: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management is the core regulatory framework for QRM in the pharmaceutical industry. TR49 Section 10 is highly consistent with ICH Q9, and its basic principles are:

blocks.zh: 對產品品質的風險評估應以科學知識和患者保護為基礎
blocks.en: Risk assessment of product quality should be based on scientific knowledge and protection of the patient

blocks.zh: 風險管理流程的努力程度、形式和文件應與風險等級相稱
blocks.en: The level of effort, formality, and documentation of the risk management process should be commensurate with the level of risk

blocks.zh: 風險管理是生命週期中的持續性活動，不是一次性事件
blocks.en: Risk management is an ongoing activity across the life cycle, not a one-time event

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 要求的三步驟：風險評估 → 風險控制 → 風險審查，TR49 在清潔驗證中完整應用了這個框架。
blocks.en: The three steps required by ICH Q9 are risk assessment → risk control → risk review, and TR49 applies this framework fully to cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: QRM 的十大效益（速記）
blocks.en: The Ten Benefits of QRM (Quick Memory Aid)

blocks.zh: TR49 列出的 QRM 效益可分為三類：
blocks.en: The QRM benefits listed in TR49 can be grouped into three categories:

blocks.zh: 預防性效益：改善規劃、了解關鍵方面、改善故障偵測能力
blocks.en: Preventive benefits: better planning, understanding of critical aspects, improved failure detection

blocks.zh: 患者保護效益：降低患者風險、選擇與 CQA 對齊的測試方法
blocks.en: Patient protection benefits: reduced patient risk, selection of test methods aligned with CQAs

blocks.zh: 業務效益：改善溝通、優化資源、建立法規信任、維持管制狀態
blocks.en: Business benefits: improved communication, optimized resources, regulatory trust, maintenance of the state of control

blocks.zh: CPP vs. CQA 在清潔驗證中的意義
blocks.en: What CPP and CQA Mean in Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數） — 影響清潔效果的可控制製程變數，是清洗「輸入」。例如：溫度、壓力、流量、清洗時間、清洗劑濃度。若 CPP 超出範圍，清潔效果可能不達標。
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter) - a controllable process variable that affects cleaning effectiveness; it is the cleaning "input." Examples: temperature, pressure, flow rate, cleaning time, cleaning agent concentration. If a CPP goes out of range, cleaning effectiveness may fall short of the standard.

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性） — 可量測的清潔「輸出」結果，直接與殘留限度相關。例如：產品殘留量、微生物殘留量、清洗劑殘留量。這些是驗收標準的依據。
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute) - a measurable cleaning "output" result directly related to the residue limit. Examples: product residue, microbial residue, cleaning agent residue. These are the basis of the acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 風險評估的核心工作就是：識別哪些 CPP 的失控會危及哪些 CQA，並設計適當的控制措施。
blocks.en: The core task of risk assessment is to identify which CPP excursions would endanger which CQAs, and to design appropriate control measures.

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛行安全檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Flight Safety Checks

blocks.zh: QRM 在清潔驗證中就像航空業的安全管理系統（SMS）：起飛前（清洗前）檢查 CPP（燃油量、油壓等），落地後（清洗後）確認 CQA（是否達到安全標準），中間有持續的風險監控。跨部門 SME 團隊就像飛行員、工程師、塔台的協同合作，缺一不可。
blocks.en: QRM in cleaning validation is like the safety management system (SMS) in aviation: before takeoff (before cleaning), the CPPs (fuel quantity, oil pressure, etc.) are checked; after landing (after cleaning), the CQAs (whether the safety standard has been met) are confirmed; and there is continuous risk monitoring in between. The cross-functional SME team is like the pilot, engineers, and control tower working together, and none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 10.2 Techniques and Tools for Risk Management and Assessment | 風險管理與評估的技術工具
blocks.en: 10.2 Techniques and Tools for Risk Management and Assessment

blocks.zh: Practical methods: FMEA, HACCP, FTA, HAZOP, Cause & Effect Analysis | 實用方法：FMEA、HACCP、FTA、HAZOP、因果分析
blocks.en: Practical methods: FMEA, HACCP, FTA, HAZOP, Cause & Effect Analysis

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 風險評估工具詳解
blocks.en: Commentary: The Risk Assessment Tools in Detail

blocks.zh: FMEA 在清潔驗證的應用
blocks.en: Applying FMEA in Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式與影響分析）是清潔驗證中最常用的風險評估工具，其核心邏輯是：
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) is the most commonly used risk assessment tool in cleaning validation, and its core logic is:

blocks.zh: Failure Mode（失效模式）：可能出問題的地方是什麼？（如：清洗劑濃度太低）
blocks.en: Failure Mode: what could go wrong? (for example, cleaning agent concentration too low)

blocks.zh: Effects（影響）：如果發生會怎樣？（如：殘留量超標，下批產品交叉污染）
blocks.en: Effects: what happens if it occurs? (for example, residue exceeds the limit and the next product is cross-contaminated)

blocks.zh: Severity（嚴重性 S）：對患者的潛在危害程度（1-10分）
blocks.en: Severity (S): the degree of potential harm to the patient (scale of 1-10)

blocks.zh: Occurrence（發生率 O）：失效發生的可能性（1-10分）
blocks.en: Occurrence (O): the likelihood that the failure occurs (scale of 1-10)

blocks.zh: Detectability（可偵測性 D）：現有管制能否偵測（1-10分，越低越容易偵測）
blocks.en: Detectability (D): whether existing controls can detect it (scale of 1-10; the lower the score, the easier to detect)

blocks.zh: RPN（風險優先數）= S × O × D：RPN 越高，優先採取行動
blocks.en: RPN (Risk Priority Number) = S × O × D: the higher the RPN, the higher the priority for action

blocks.zh: 其他風險工具速覽
blocks.en: Other Risk Tools at a Glance

blocks.zh: HACCP（危害分析關鍵控制點）：系統性識別關鍵控制點（CCPs），設定監控界限；源自食品安全，在生物製品清洗中適用於滅活步驟
blocks.en: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points): systematically identifies critical control points (CCPs) and sets monitoring limits; it originates in food safety and, in the cleaning of biological products, is applicable to the inactivation step

blocks.zh: FTA（故障樹分析）：從「最差結果」往回推導可能的失效路徑，圖形化呈現，適合分析複雜 CIP 系統的系統性風險
blocks.en: FTA (Fault Tree Analysis): works backward from the "worst outcome" to derive possible failure paths, presented graphically; suited to analyzing systemic risks of complex CIP systems

blocks.zh: HAZOP（危害與可操作性研究）：以引導詞（更多/更少/沒有/相反）系統審查偏差情境，適合清洗程序的系統性審查
blocks.en: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study): uses guide words (more/less/no/reverse) to systematically review deviation scenarios; suited to systematic review of cleaning procedures

blocks.zh: 因果分析（魚骨圖）：識別影響清潔效果的所有潛在原因（人、機、料、法、環），適合根本原因調查
blocks.en: Cause & effect analysis (fishbone diagram): identifies all potential causes affecting cleaning effectiveness (people, machines, materials, methods, environment); suited to root cause investigation

blocks.zh: 風險分析在變更控制中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Risk Analysis in Change Control

blocks.zh: TR49 明確指出，變更控制必須進行風險分析：
blocks.en: TR49 states explicitly that change control must include risk analysis:

blocks.zh: 低風險變更（如：增加沖洗時間）→ 幾乎不需要額外測試
blocks.en: Low-risk changes (for example, increasing rinse time) → little or no additional testing needed

blocks.zh: 高風險變更（如：更換清洗劑種類）→ 需要大量測試，甚至再驗證
blocks.en: High-risk changes (for example, changing the type of cleaning agent) → extensive testing needed, possibly revalidation

blocks.zh: 經濟效益評估：若風險分析顯示預期變更無經濟效益，可能決定不實施該變更
blocks.en: Economic benefit assessment: if the risk analysis shows that the intended change has no economic benefit, a decision may be made not to implement it

blocks.zh: 這體現了 QRM 的務實性：以科學為依據，以風險等級決定投入的資源程度。
blocks.en: This reflects the pragmatism of QRM: be guided by science, and let the level of risk determine the level of resources invested.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 2
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 情境：你的工廠計畫將 CIP 清洗系統的清洗劑由鹼性清洗劑 A 更換為新型環保清洗劑 B（pH 值相近，但界面活性劑不同）。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your plant plans to change the cleaning agent in its CIP system from alkaline cleaning agent A to a new eco-friendly cleaning agent B (similar pH, but a different surfactant).

blocks.zh: 問題 1：根據 TR49 Section 10.2，這屬於低風險還是高風險變更？需要哪些後續行動？
blocks.en: Question 1: According to TR49 Section 10.2, is this a low-risk or a high-risk change? What follow-up actions are needed?

blocks.zh: 問題 2：如果要用 FMEA 評估這個變更，你會識別哪些關鍵失效模式？
blocks.en: Question 2: If you were to use FMEA to evaluate this change, what key failure modes would you identify?

blocks.zh: 參考答案方向：
blocks.en: Suggested answer direction:

blocks.zh: 問題 1：更換清洗劑種類屬於高風險變更（即使 pH 相近）。需進行完整風險評估、清洗效果測試（至少針對最差情況產品）、清洗劑殘留分析方法驗證，可能需要再驗證或部分驗證。
blocks.en: Question 1: Changing the type of cleaning agent is a high-risk change (even if the pH is similar). A full risk assessment, cleaning effectiveness testing (at least for the worst-case product), validation of the analytical method for the cleaning agent residue, and possibly revalidation or partial validation are needed.

blocks.zh: 問題 2：關鍵失效模式包括：新清洗劑對目標污漬（蛋白質、DNA 等）清潔效果不足、新清洗劑本身殘留難以偵測（影響 CQA）、新清洗劑對設備材質的相容性（腐蝕或萃出）。
blocks.en: Question 2: Key failure modes include: the new cleaning agent is insufficiently effective against the target soils (protein, DNA, etc.); residue of the new cleaning agent is hard to detect (affecting CQAs); and compatibility of the new cleaning agent with equipment materials (corrosion or extractables).

blocks.zh: Section 10 Summary — QRM in Cleaning Validation Life Cycle | QRM 於清潔驗證生命週期的應用總結
blocks.en: Section 10 Summary - QRM in Cleaning Validation Life Cycle

blocks.zh: Phase 1: Assessment | 評估
blocks.en: Phase 1: Assessment

blocks.zh: Identify CPPs and CQAs | 識別 CPP 與 CQA
blocks.en: Identify CPPs and CQAs

blocks.zh: Apply FMEA / HAZOP / HACCP | 應用風險評估工具
blocks.en: Apply FMEA / HAZOP / HACCP

blocks.zh: Determine scope of validation | 決定驗證範圍
blocks.en: Determine scope of validation

blocks.zh: Prioritize resources | 優化資源分配
blocks.en: Prioritize resources

blocks.zh: Phase 2: Control | 控制
blocks.en: Phase 2: Control

blocks.zh: Implement risk mitigation | 實施風險緩解措施
blocks.en: Implement risk mitigation

blocks.zh: Establish design space | 建立設計空間
blocks.en: Establish design space

blocks.zh: Execute validation protocols | 執行驗證方案
blocks.en: Execute validation protocols

blocks.zh: Apply change control | 應用變更控制
blocks.en: Apply change control

blocks.zh: Phase 3: Review | 審查
blocks.en: Phase 3: Review

blocks.zh: Periodic risk re-evaluation | 定期再評估
blocks.en: Periodic risk re-evaluation

blocks.zh: Monitor CPPs and CQAs | 持續監控
blocks.en: Monitor CPPs and CQAs

blocks.zh: Update risk assessments | 更新風險評估
blocks.en: Update risk assessments

blocks.zh: Communicate to stakeholders | 與利害關係人溝通
blocks.en: Communicate to stakeholders
